read.en: Lumentum fell 1.8% on Nov 10 to $585.57, trading $570.41–612.62. It is above the 5-day ($571.4) and below the 10-day ($689.5), 30-day ($858.7), 100-day ($848.6) and 200-day ($810.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($842.95), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月10日下跌 1.8%，收于 $585.57，盘中区间 $570.41–612.62。股价位于 5 日（$571.4）均线上方，10 日（$689.5）、30 日（$858.7）、100 日（$848.6）和 200 日（$810.2）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$842.95），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close lost the $594.8 Jul 29 low, now resistance, after the $612.62 high stalled under the $616.66 Nov 9 high; the 5-day ($571.4) held. Resistance is $594.8–602.3 (Jul 29 and Jul 28 lows), then $612.6–626.8 (Nov 9–10 highs, Nov 4 close) and $680–684. Support is $570.4–571.4 (Nov 10 low, 5-day), then $545–559 and $518–528. A close above $602.3 would target $613–627; below $570, $545–559.
